title: Your First Weekend at Baylor University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Unpack with the Help of Move2BU
cards.subtitle: A high-energy welcome to your new residence hall
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall during your morning time slot. Student volunteers will help unload your vehicle and carry belongings to your room in minutes.
cards.short_summary: Move2BU is the university's coordinated move-in event where volunteers assist new students with their belongings.
cards.evidence_claim: Move2BU for first-year communities takes place on August 20, 2026, from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm.
cards.access_notes: Requires assigned move-in time slot and residence hall placement.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: Visit the Live Bear Mascots
cards.subtitle: Meet Judge Indy and Judge Belle at the heart of campus
cards.notes: Walk through the habitat walkway to see the American black bears. The facility features a waterfall and pools for the university's official live mascots.
cards.short_summary: The Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat is a licensed zoo facility on campus housing Baylor's live bear mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Bear Habitat is open to the public daily from 9:30 a.m. until 6 p.m. free of charge.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Baylor Bear Habitat
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9:30 AM - 6:00 PM; bears may be indoors during inclement weather.

cards.title: Attend the Candlelight Worship Service
cards.subtitle: A reflective Sunday evening tradition on the mall
cards.notes: Join fellow new students on Fountain Mall for a Sunday night worship service that marks the spiritual beginning of the academic year.
cards.short_summary: The Candlelight Worship Service is a signature Welcome Week event held outdoors on Fountain Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Candlelight Worship Service is scheduled for Sunday, August 23, 2026, from 8:00 pm to 9:00 pm on Fountain Mall.
cards.source_title: First 50 Days - New Student Programs | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students as part of Welcome Week programming.

cards.title: Run the Field at McLane Stadium
cards.subtitle: A high-speed tradition for all new students
cards.notes: Don your gold Line jersey and run onto the field before kickoff. You'll form a human tunnel for the team before heading to the dedicated student section.
cards.short_summary: The Baylor Line is a tradition where new students run across the football field before home games at McLane Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Line, established in 1970, consists of new students who run onto the field at McLane Stadium before each home football game.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Baylor Line jersey and a student ticket for the game.

cards.title: Explore the Armstrong Browning Library
cards.subtitle: A quiet retreat with world-class stained glass
cards.notes: Visit this research library to see the world's largest collection of Robert and Elizabeth Barrett Browning's works and 62 stained glass windows.
cards.short_summary: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is a dedicated research center and museum on the Baylor campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is free and open to the public, with hours typically from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Mix a Float at Dr Pepper Hour
cards.subtitle: A sweet Tuesday afternoon tradition since 1953
cards.notes: Head to the Barfield Drawing Room for a Dr Pepper float. It is a weekly social hour where students, faculty, and staff gather for free treats.
cards.short_summary: Dr Pepper Hour is a long-standing Baylor tradition where the community gathers for Dr Pepper floats every Tuesday.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour occurs every Tuesday from 3:00 pm to 4:00 pm in the Barfield Drawing Room of the Bill Daniel Student Center.
cards.source_title: Dr Pepper Hour - Student Activities | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Held weekly on Tuesdays; check the student activities calendar for kickoff events.

cards.title: Listen to the McLane Carillon
cards.subtitle: The soundtrack of the Baylor campus
cards.notes: Find a spot on Founders Mall to hear the 48-bell carillon. The bells play hymns and university songs throughout the day from the iconic gold tower.
cards.short_summary: The McLane Carillon in Pat Neff Hall is a 22-ton instrument that provides musical performances for the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McLane Carillon in the tower of Pat Neff Hall features 48 cast bronze bells and is played by the University Carillonneur.
cards.access_notes: Best heard from the grounds around Pat Neff Hall or Founders Mall.

cards.title: Grab a Coffee at Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: The classic student hangout just off campus
cards.notes: Order a 'Cowboy Coffee' and find a seat on the back patio. This converted house is a staple for studying and late-night student socializing.
cards.short_summary: Common Grounds is a popular local coffee shop located adjacent to the Baylor University campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds is a long-standing coffee shop near campus frequently featured in student media like The Baylor Lariat.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check local listings for specific late-night hours.

cards.title: Join a Club at Late Night
cards.subtitle: Explore 400+ student organizations in one night
cards.notes: Browse booths from hundreds of student groups across campus. It's the primary way to find your niche, from intramural sports to academic societies.
cards.short_summary: Late Night is an annual fall event where student organizations recruit new members through a campus-wide fair.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night 2026 is scheduled for Friday, August 28, from 8:00 pm to 10:30 pm, featuring 400+ student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Held at various locations including the Student Union and McLane Student Life Center.

cards.title: Attend a Performance at Waco Hall
cards.subtitle: The historic home of Baylor's major productions
cards.notes: Visit this 2,200-seat theater for university events. It hosts everything from orientation sessions to the famous All-University Sing performances.
cards.short_summary: Waco Hall is a historic multipurpose theater on the Baylor campus used for major university events and student productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Waco Hall is a 2,200-seat theater that hosts a variety of university events and is managed by Student Activities.
cards.source_title: Waco Hall | Student Activities | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Access depends on specific event schedules and ticket availability.
